rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are presidential letters appointing the chairman of a temporary policy commission, defining an objective inquiry into a national problem, listing specific subjects for study, requesting recommendations within a fixed period, promising cooperation from agencies whose “functions and interests relate” to the assignment, inviting consultation with private interests, and financing the commission from a presidential emergency appropriation. The unusually close language and matching sequence go well beyond generic commission boilerplate. C04 and C17 share substantial commission-letter structure, but neither matches the child’s cooperation and financing provisions as closely as C11.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am delighted that you are willing to serve as chairman of the Commission, and I hereby appoint you as such.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am very pleased that you have agreed to serve as the Chairman of the President's Materials Policy Commission.
shared_material.explanation: Both open the operative portion by confirming the addressee’s chairmanship of a presidential commission.

shared_material.child_excerpt: We need a study that is both objective and realistic. That is what I want your Commission to do.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The task of the Commission, therefore, will be to make an objective inquiry into all major aspects of the problem
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize the commission’s central assignment as an objective study of a broad national policy problem.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I would like the Commission to take the following specific matters into account. 1. ... 2. ... 3. ... 4. ... 5. ... 6.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I believe the Commission should study, together with any other aspects deemed by it to be pertinent, such questions ... as: (1) ... (2) ... (3) ... (4) ... (5)
shared_material.explanation: The letters use the same transition into a numbered catalogue of specific study subjects.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you will have the full cooperation of all the Executive agencies whose functions and interests relate to your assignment.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission will enjoy the cooperation of all agencies of Government whose functions and interests relate to your assignment.
shared_material.explanation: This is highly similar, nearly verbatim language in the same closing administrative position.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you will want, of course, to keep in close touch with other groups concerned about this problem, including ... the aviation industry.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: And of course you will want to solicit the cooperation of private industry.
shared_material.explanation: Both follow the agency-cooperation assurance with an expectation of consultation with affected private interests.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Arrangements will be made to meet the expenses of your Commission out of the Emergency fund for the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The direct expenses of the Commission and its immediate staff will be defrayed from the appropriation Emergencies (National Defense) 1951.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by assigning commission expenses to a presidential emergency appropriation.
